have HzipSubset : ∀ (as : List P.Ident) (bs : List P.Expr),
      ∀ {x : P.Ident}, x ∈ (as.zip bs).unzip.1 → x ∈ as := by
    intro as
    induction as with
    | nil =>
      intro bs x Hx
      simp at Hx
    | cons a as ih =>
      intro bs x Hx
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp at Hx
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at Hx
        rcases Hx with Hx | Hx
        · simp_all
        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a (ih bs Hx)

have HzipSubset : ∀ (as : List P.Ident) (bs : List P.Expr),
      ∀ {x : P.Ident}, x ∈ (as.zip bs).unzip.1 → x ∈ as := by
    intro as
    induction as with
    | nil =>
      intro bs x Hx
      simp at Hx
    | cons a as ih =>
      intro bs x Hx
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp at Hx
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at Hx
        rcases Hx with Hx | Hx
        · simp_all
        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a (ih bs Hx)

    | nil =>
      intro bs x Hx
      simp at Hx
    | cons a as ih =>
      intro bs x Hx
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp at Hx
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at Hx
        rcases Hx with Hx | Hx
        · simp_all
        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a (ih bs Hx)
